name: zoflib_cloud
description: Provider-neutral cloud storage contract. Every language package implements these concepts and operations with idiomatic naming and declares the contract_version it implements.

path_rules.folders: A folder is a key prefix ending in '/'. Listing returns the next level only: files directly under the path and folders as common prefixes.
path_rules.exact_keys: Keys are kept byte for byte as given. No Unicode normalization, case folding or trimming is applied to stored keys; 'café' in NFC and NFD are two different items.
path_rules.ordering: list and search return items in ascending order of the key's UTF-8 bytes.
path_rules.root: Every operation names a root (bucket, container or drive) from listRoots.

ConnectionConfig.note: Never holds secret values. credential_ref and session_token_ref name a secret the host app resolves through a credential callback. allow_insecure_http defaults to false and is for local development only.

CloudItem.note: size, modified and etag are null for folders. metadata is an optional provider bag.

Page.note: next_token is opaque and null on the last page. Consumers never parse it.

OperationOptions.note: overwrite defaults to fail. destructive defaults to false; delete and the delete half of move refuse to run without it. recursive defaults to false.

OperationReceipt.note: Never contains authorization headers, access keys, signed URLs or raw response bodies.

Error.note: code is one of spec/errors.json. message and provider_code are safe to show; secrets are redacted before an error is built.

search.matching: Files whose name (last path segment) contains query, compared after NFC normalization and Unicode case folding. Bounded recursive listing; streams; stops at limit with truncated true.

download.returns: bytes (streamed to a temp file, then atomic replace in host apps)

upload.rename_rule: With overwrite rename, 'name.ext' becomes 'name (1).ext', then 'name (2).ext', ... the first free name in the same folder.

move.note: Copy then delete on S3. Receipt state source_deleted when both halves ran, copied when only the copy ran.

delete.note: A folder with contents needs recursive. On versioned buckets the receipt reports a delete marker, not permanent deletion.

cancellation: A cancelled operation returns the cancelled error. A cancel set before the call makes no change at all; search cancelled mid-way returns cancelled and never more items than it had produced.
security: HTTPS by default; presets cannot turn it off.
Authorization headers, query signatures, tokens and secret fields are redacted from logs, errors and receipts.
The library never persists credentials; host apps keep them in the platform secret store.
